description: Fuji于1983年推出的胶片相机。配备Fujinon 38 mm f/2,8, 4 elements/4 groups (UV filter incorporated).。快门速度1/8 — 1/500 Seiko ESF 2-blade electronic shutter.。感光度50–100–200–400 ISO. If set to auto-identification, the camera defaults to ISO 100.。0,9 m to infinity.。

specs.镜头: Fujinon 38 mm f/2,8, 4 elements/4 groups (UV filter incorporated).
specs.感光度: 50–100–200–400 ISO. If set to auto-identification, the camera defaults to ISO 100.
specs.重量: 129,5 x 79,5 x 58 mm; 445 g without batteries.
specs.英文简介: The Fujica DL-100 (Auto Ace in Japan) is a compact autofocus camera released in 1983.
